text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Mejiro 
Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Today was another fun day, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Checking out places I don't usually go 
really gives me some fresh inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"That was a truly wonderful break! My 
muscles are thrilled to enjoy some scenery 
different from the usual!"
choice_data_list: I'm just glad you were able to enjoy it.
I'm just glad you were able to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I used to worry way too much about 
walking on eggshells before, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, even getting ready to 
go out is part of the fun!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Can we stop by a bookstore 
before going back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now, we've arrived! I'll go buy it right 
away!
choice_data_list: So what are you planning to buy?
What are you planning to buy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's an info magazine about good outing 
spots. I thought I'd use it as reference 
for next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well then, please wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder which magazine to pick... Maybe 
one featuring gourmet restaurants would be 
better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, you shopping too, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dober. I'm just looking for an 
information magazine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering where I should go 
with Trainer next~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If we're going out anyway, it'd be better 
to go to a recommended spot, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I guess so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, looking around like this, there are 
so many options~. I can't decide!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just thought, Ryan looks like she's 
having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Y-You think so? I feel like it's 
pretty normal, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I think it's pretty rare to see Ryan this 
excited about something other than muscle 
training~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not excited at all... I'm totally 
normal, totally normal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's totally not true! It's 
completely normal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, now that we've got the 
info magazine, let's decide together where 
to go next!
choice_data_list: We need to set a date before that.
We need to set a date before that.

Looks like the next one's gonna be fun 
too.

Looks like the next one's going to be fun 
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, now that we've got the 
info magazine, let's decide together where 
to go next!
choice_data_list: We need to set a date before that.
We need to set a date before that.

Looks like the next one's gonna be fun 
too.

Looks like the next one's going to be fun 
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Setting a date...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Come to think of it, we haven't even 
made plans to go out yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I rushed ahead all on my own. I 
really did let it go to my head... It's so 
embarrassing...
choice_data_list:
It just means it's that good of a 
breather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hauu... Trying to cover for me just makes 
it more embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break by going out seemed to 
fulfill her emotionally far more than I 
had expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's gonna be a blast, 
guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we go check out some 
spots where we can get active next!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How about a climbing gym? It builds 
muscle, plus it's twice as fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!? I'm not acting giddy! I'm 
perfectly normal!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she thoroughly enjoyed our 
outing for a breather.
